info.title: ComiGo Mobile API
info.description:
Single client contract for the ComiGo unified mobile application, which contains both the passenger and driver experience on one account.

Supersedes passenger-app.openapi.json and driver-app.openapi.json (Decision 011).

The /api/v1/passenger/** and /api/v1/driver/** namespaces are retained: they are role-scoped resource namespaces, not app boundaries. Mode is a client concept; the server authorises on role, resource ownership and gate state.

Every operation carries an `x-routeshare-status` extension:
  IMPLEMENTED      - live in apps/api today
  PLANNED_SLICE_NN - specified, to be built in that slice of the ComiGo backend plan
  CUT              - deliberately removed from the product, with a reason

Plan: docs/development/implementation/tasks/comigo-unified-app-backend/

actionPath.description: Where the app should send the user to clear the refusal. Populated on gated 403s and 409s; null otherwise.

RideSearchResult.description: A scored ride match. Ride search is stateless; results are returned by POST /ride-searches and carried client-side into ride detail.

bandStatus.description: D06 shows this per vehicle: approved papers with no band still cannot carry a trip.

vehicleClass.description: Drives the seat cap (D07) and the range the band must sit inside.

AppContextGate.description: A reason the caller cannot do something, as data the app renders (S07-S13, D34, D40).

AppContextActiveTrip.description: Drives the resume bar on P01b and D08b, and the mode-switch sheets S10/S11.

AppContextBadges.description: Tab badge rules per board S14. Home and Account are dots; Trips and Inbox are counts; the action tab is never badged.

AppContextResponse.description: Everything the ComiGo app shell needs on cold start and after a mode switch, in one call. Fields owned by later slices return safe zero values until those slices land, so the shell never has to reshape.

DriverReinstatementRequest.description: A deactivated driver's request to be reinstated (board D34). Only one may be open at a time.

VehicleClass.description: A class of vehicle: what it may carry, and the range its per-km band must sit inside.

RateBandFactor.description: One line of the arithmetic on D39. Typed by an admin as justification; never an input the band was computed from.

RatePositionOption.description: Where a rate sits in the band and what that costs in visibility. Copy, not a ranking multiplier — the server applies no such thing.

RateBand.description: The band ComiGo assessed and the rate the driver chose inside it (D39, D39b, D39c, D40). A driver never types a price; they pick a point in this range.

setBy.description: Always "ComiGo" — the assessing admin is never named to the driver.
